title: Constraint-driven sampling & schema-compliance hook for streaming/function-call interplay
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build a deterministic test harness and runtime hook that validates schema adherence when constrained-sampling strategies are active, with special focus on streamed partial outputs and tool/function-calling interleavings. This ticket covers: (1) a schema-compliance callback in the streaming pipeline that can accept a partial token window and request decoder adjustments; (2) a constrained-sampling test driver capable of exercising temperature/top-k/top-p variants and sampler seed replay; (3) scenarios where function/tool calls are emitted mid-stream and the schema verifier must not prematurely reject valid but incomplete objects. Goal is to catch regressions introduced by recent kernel scheduling and KV-cache changes and ensure graceful fallback policies for production requests.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming hook evaluates partial token buffers without blocking generation and returns deterministic pass/fail signals
Constrained-sampling driver can replay at least 5 deterministic seeds across 3 sampling configurations and reproduce failures locally
Tool/function-call interleaving scenarios produce either valid schema-compliant outputs or trigger well-defined fallback rules (canonical error object + telemetry)
Automated suite runs in CI against matrix of: small/medium/large open models and both quantized and fp16 binaries
Performance overhead of schema hook on p99 latency is <5% in canary runs or flagged with a mitigation plan
test_plan: Matrix: models=[rwkv-1b, mixtral-8b, llama-2-13b], modes=[streaming, non-streaming], binaries=[fp16, int8_q4]

Scenarios: (A) full-object streaming where JSON arrives across multiple chunks, (B) mid-object function call insertion that returns structured args, (C) partial-escape sequences and stray commas to verify sanitizer resilience
Instrumentation: capture token-level traces, decoder logits snapshot, hook decision timestamps, and KV-cache hits for each run
Failure repro steps: seed replay, reduced context reproduction, cross-binary comparison, and automated bisect on recent kernel commits
CI integration: nightly job that runs a minimized subset (3 seeds x 2 models x 2 sampling configs) with flaky-tolerance and auto-ticket creation on regression threshold
